# Kybl

> Kybl is a free, fast file manager (macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, and iPhone by sideloading) for object storage, cloud drives and servers: Amazon S3 and any S3-compatible endpoint, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, SFTP, SSH, FTP/FTPS, WebDAV and the local disk, side by side. It adds split panes, workspaces, terminals and an SSH client, folder sync, mirroring and copies between any two connections. Built with Rust and Tauri.

Kybl (pronounced "kibble", from the Czech and Slovak word for bucket) talks to your storage and servers directly and keeps passwords and keys in an encrypted vault whose key lives in the operating system keychain. Or use Kybl Storage: S3 storage run by Kybl, 10 GB free, encrypted at rest, connected from the app without copying keys.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://kybl.app/): connections, features, SSH and terminals, sync, Kybl Storage, FAQ and downloads
- [Features](https://kybl.app/features/): every screen, menu and flow in screenshots
- [Manual](https://kybl.app/manual/): how to use every feature, step by step, with a keyboard shortcut reference
- [Full text for LLMs](https://kybl.app/llms-full.txt): everything on the homepage as plain text
- [Source code](https://github.com/erikkubica/kybl): the app's repository on GitHub

## Key facts

- Price: free download
- Platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows (64-bit installer), Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm), Android (APK), iPhone and iPad (sideloaded .ipa)
- Object storage: Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Hetzner Object Storage, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces, MinIO, Ceph, any S3-compatible endpoint, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage, Kybl Storage
- Cloud drives: Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox
- Servers: SFTP, SSH (opens as a terminal), FTP and FTPS, WebDAV
- Desktop: up to six split panes saved as workspaces, commander keys (F5 copy, F6 move), command palette, terminal panes (your computer's shell, including PowerShell, Command Prompt, WSL and Git Bash on Windows, or SSH), SSH tunnels, custom shell actions, mount as a drive (macOS and Linux)
- Import: FileZilla Site Manager and ~/.ssh/config
- Security: secrets in an encrypted vault, key in macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager or Linux Secret Service (Android Keystore on phones)
- Sync: upload, download or two-way folder sync from the menu bar or system tray; mirror with a dry run; resumable, verified copies and moves between connections
- Phones: same connections, photo backup to any connection, background transfers on Android
- Kybl Storage: 10 GB free, stored in the EU, every file encrypted at rest (AES-256, SSE-C) with a key per bucket; not end-to-end, Kybl's servers encrypt files on the way in
- Account site: https://app.kybl.app/
